correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md lines 33–70. With rates per edge, every core vertex has rate 1 to g and r to s, and g has aggregate rate m−1 into the core. Internal edges cancel from the class generator, so strong lumpability gives the same entire absorption law from s. Reset at s is a self-event. The finite killed system is transient since all states have a positive-probability path to a within a common finite time. Writing D=r²+(m+1)r+1, elimination gives G−S=(m+r)/D and (S−1)/(2+r)=1+(m+r)/D, hence S=r+4+(r+2m−1)/D, equivalent to the claimed mean and giving S(0)=2m+3. Differentiation independently gives D²+D−(r+2m−1)D′ as the numerator. For m≥3 its coefficients change sign once, the value at 0 is negative and the value at √2 is m(3+2√2)+11+8√2>0, proving a unique global minimum in the stated interval. At the root, F/m² tends uniformly to r²−2 on the interval. The 1/m coefficient of F/m² at √2 is 2√2+3; implicit differentiation gives the claimed rate correction. The mean's 1/m coefficient at fixed r>0 is −1−3/r−2/r², and its leading term is stationary at √2; this gives the stated optimal mean correction. An independent exact full-generator check compared H empty and H=K₂ at m=3,r=1/2 and found mean 161/26 and Laplace transform 3258/9767 at z=1/3 in both cases (replay: evidence/3/full_generator_check.py with Python and SymPy; observed output: evidence/3/full_generator_check.out). This checks those instances, not the universal quantifier. The frozen verify.py was inspected, not executed.

value.rationale: The coned core is a natural motif for separating internal complexity from excursions into a trap: every core vertex has the same exit rate despite arbitrary interconnection. The valuable part is not merely applying lumpability to a finite graph. It gives a uniform comparison between linearly diverging unrestarted means and bounded optimally restarted means, with a unique finite-core rate and first corrections. The same unmarked clique-tail topology can instead disfavor restart when the reset vertex is moved to the gateway, making the dependence on the marked dynamics scientifically useful.
